name: Selvin PaulRaj K — Portfolio Agent
description: Agent for AI Engineer Selvin PaulRaj K (Chennai, India; open to AI Engineer roles). Send a job description for an evidence-cited fit report, or ask anything for his profile. Deterministic, no LLM: every claim cites portfolio data.
